answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 97 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the onyx challenge, the sable audit can replay the reef history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 3386 identities would post 4624 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
